'''57''' was one of the six rookie [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], the others being [[16]], [[Ace (clone trooper)|18]], [[23]], [[35 (Ando Prime)|35]] and [[44]], sent from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] that was selected for a special mission to [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] to investigate the disappearance of the [[313th Legion]] and its leader, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Po Bandis]]. He was a [[Clone medic/Legends|medic]] who had been patching [[Vargus]] up, which earned him the nickname "Patch".<ref name="TCW: DYD: TLL" />
